description_for_human: A free scam checker for India. Paste a suspicious message or upload a screenshot to see the warning signs and safest next action.
description_for_model: Chetana performs local-first, advisory scam-pattern checks on suspicious text, links, QR requests, payment proofs, and screenshot text. It returns one of four evidence states (high_risk, caution, needs_review, or low_signal), reasons, and the safest next action. It does not certify content as safe, verify UPI IDs or phone numbers against a comprehensive fraud database, or detect deepfakes. English is live; Hindi screenshot reading and translation-assisted checks are beta.
